name: online_man
description:
Online Linux manual: action=search to search, action=read to fetch a specific man page.
Search goes through Arch manual pages; page reads can use Arch man pages or man7.org. For normal reading with read, set max_chars to at least 8000; only lower it when you just need an excerpt.

action.description: search to search, read to fetch a page.

name.description: Required for action=read: man page name.

limit.description: search only: maximum number of results, default 10.

source.description: read only: source site, default auto.

max_chars.description: read only: maximum number of characters to return.
